name: ridesharing-and-tracker-static-vanilla-js
description: Los Angeles Rideshare Booking, Fare Estimator & Live Driver Tracking built with Static HTML, Vanilla JavaScript (ES Modules), and modern Google Maps Platform APIs.

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { const required = ['index.html', 'app.js', 'styles.css', 'server.mjs', 'package.json']; for (const file of required) { if (!fs.existsSync(file)) throw new Error('Missing required asset: ' + file); } console.log('Build verified: syntax valid and all static assets present.'); })"
